_comment: 桩注册表：尚未编码完整条目的规范。字段：总数与官方来源。使用前先补全为独立 JSON。

moose.name: Meta-analysis of Observational Studies in Epidemiology (MOOSE)
moose.citation: Stroup DF, et al. JAMA. 2000;283:2008-2012. 注意：2024 年有更新版本（BMJ Global Health 等），投稿前核对最新版。

mars.name: Meta-Analysis Reporting Standards (APA)
mars.citation: Appelbaum M, et al. J Appl Dev Psychol. 2018 (APA MARS).

prisma-nma.name: PRISMA extension for Network Meta-Analyses
prisma-nma.citation: Hutton B, et al. Ann Intern Med. 2015;162:777-784.

prisma-dta.name: PRISMA extension for Diagnostic Test Accuracy studies
prisma-dta.citation: McInnes MDF, et al. PLoS Med. 2018;15(11):e1002665.

amstar-2.name: AMSTAR 2 (assessment of systematic reviews)
amstar-2.citation: Shea BJ, et al. BMJ. 2017;358:j4008. 7 个 critical domains。

robis.name: ROBIS (risk of bias in systematic reviews)
robis.citation: Whiting P, et al. J Clin Epidemiol. 2016.

rameses.name: RAMESES publication standards (realist & meta-narrative reviews)
rameses.citation: Wong G, et al. BMC Med. 2013;11:20 (realist) / 11:21 (meta-narrative); 质量标准: HS&DR 2014;2(30).

emerge.name: eMERGe reporting guidance for meta-ethnography
emerge.citation: France EF, et al. BMC Med Res Methodol. 2019;19:45.

mmat.name: Mixed Methods Appraisal Tool (MMAT), version 2018
mmat.citation: Hong QN, et al. 2018. 每类设计 5 条目（定性/定量随机/非随机/定量描述/混合）。

grade-cerqual.name: GRADE-CERQual (confidence in evidence from reviews of qualitative research)
grade-cerqual.citation: Lewin S, et al. Implement Sci. 2018;13(Suppl 1).

adapted_conventions.rapid-adapted: 适配版 PRISMA 2020 + 省略项披露表（每省略一步，说明理由与风险）。依据 Cochrane RRMG：Garritty et al. J Clin Epidemiol. 2020;128:1-11.
adapted_conventions.narrative-adapted: SANRA 适配（见 sanra.json），输出时必须标注 adapted。
adapted_conventions.mixed-methods-adapted: PRISMA 2020 主体适配 + MMAT 子报告。
